environment.organisation: QA-GEO, role SUPER_ADMIN, existing session valid (no login needed)
environment.pool: P = 1000; U = 703 at start and at end; 7 analyses both times; ring data-status "healthy"
environment.stateChanges: None. A Playwright context route aborted every non-GET call to /geo/api for the whole run (write guard, verified with a probe POST that was blocked). The app itself sent no write request (guard log contains only the probe). Manage Scope of kids toys and Decathlon 27bec573 opened read-only; no tick, no save, no analysis created/edited/deleted, no back-office access.

sideFindings: Accessibility: the Brand / Topic sort button keeps the static aria-label "Sort by brand or topic ascending" (views.reports.ariaSortBrandOrTopic) even when the table is sorted by Prompts or would sort descending; the Prompts button keeps "Sort by prompts" (views.reports.ariaSortPrompts) in every state. The labels do not describe the current/next sort (aria-sort on the th is correct).
Console: repeated 410 errors on cdn.brandfetch.io lettermark icons (4 logos) on every dashboard load; logos fall back, cosmetic only.
The ring popover uses the wizard keys (wizard.pool.title, wizard.pool.summary, wizard.pool.inUseAcross, wizard.pool.free) — consistent with "the wizard's ring".
csvProposals: TC-GEO-1240-004, step "When the user sorts the Prompts column": expected result "ordered by Prompts ascending then descending" -> observed first click descending (largest first). Proposal: "The analyses are ordered by Prompts descending then ascending; the Brand sort is removed" if the PO confirms descending-first is intended, or keep the CSV and raise a bug if ascending-first is required. To confirm with PO (AC4 only says "sortable").

TC-GEO-1240-004, test data "Sum of the Prompts column (Show more to list every analysis)": with 7 analyses no Show more / Show all button is shown (views.reports.showMore / showAll). Proposal: "Sum of the Prompts column (use Show all {{total}} analyses if the list is truncated)".

TC-GEO-1240-001, step "Then a pool block is shown in the header of the Analysis table": the ring sits to the left of the analyses count and reads "703 / 1000 prompts". Proposal: "Next to the number of analyses (e.g. "5 analyses"), the ring reads "U / P prompts"".
TC-GEO-1240-001, step "When the user hovers the ring": add the exact popover content: "Prompt pool — U of P — In use across analyses U — Free in the pool P - U".

results.title: The sortable Prompts column shows the slots of each analysis and adds up to the pool block
results.error: Step "When the user sorts the Prompts column" — Expected: "The analyses are ordered by Prompts ascending then descending; the Brand sort is removed". Observed: 1st click = DESCENDING (174, 169, 140, 133, 80, 4, 3; aria-sort="descending"), 2nd click = ASCENDING (3, 4, 80, 133, 140, 169, 174; aria-sort="ascending"). The order of the two directions is the reverse of the expected result. The Brand sort is removed (Brand header aria-sort="none").

steps.title: Given the GEO dashboard of organisation T is loaded
steps.expected: The Analysis table is displayed
steps.observed: Analysis table with 7 rows, default sort Brand / Topic ascending

steps.title: Then a "Prompts" column is shown after Categories
steps.expected: "Prompts" header right after "Categories"
steps.observed: Headers: Brand / Topic | Countries | Categories | Prompts | Last update | Actions (views.reports.colPrompts); Prompts header is a sort button "Sort by prompts"

steps.title: And the column adds up to the pool block
steps.testData: Sum of the Prompts column (Show more to list every analysis)
steps.expected: The sum equals U of the pool block "U / P"
steps.observed: adidas 169 + BYD 4 + Decathlon (Outdoor Gear, Sporting Goods) 133 + Decathlon (Articles De Sport) 80 + kids toys 3 + Orange 140 + Toyota 174 = 703 = U of "703 / 1000". All 7 analyses listed; no "Show more" / "Show all" button (list not truncated).

steps.title: And the value of an analysis equals its kept prompts across its markets
steps.testData: Analysis A (Manage Scope > Prompts: ticked rows)
steps.expected: The Prompts value of A equals its number of ticked rows
steps.observed: kids toys 796a92e9 (MA (FR)): 3 ticked rows, tracker "703 / 1000 prompts · 3 selected" = column 3. Decathlon 27bec573 (GB (EN) + FR (FR)): 80 ticked rows (40 GB + 40 FR), "· 80 selected" = column 80. Manage Scope opened read-only, nothing ticked or saved.

steps.title: When the user sorts the Prompts column
steps.expected: The analyses are ordered by Prompts ascending then descending; the Brand sort is removed
steps.observed: 1st click: descending (174 → 3); 2nd click: ascending (3 → 174). Brand sort removed (aria-sort="none").

results.notes: Row values (Brand sort): adidas 169 (IN, MA, US), BYD 4 (ES), Decathlon 133 (FR, GB), Decathlon 80 (FR, GB), kids toys 3 (MA), Orange 140 (FR, MA), Toyota 174 (ES, FR, US); sum 703 = U. The only failing point is the direction of the first click; AC4 of GEO-1240 only says "sortable" and does not fix the first direction, so this may be a test-design issue — see CSV proposal. Sorting sent no write request (write guard log empty). After a reload the default Brand ascending sort is back (sort not persisted).
